diagnosis: Loose condenser mounting brackets vibrating against cabinet
action_taken: Tightened brackets and added silicone vibration dampers
additional_remarks: Advised customer to monitor temperatures closely.

diagnosis: Thermostat sensor calibration drifted after voltage fluctuation
action_taken: Recalibrated digital thermostat and replaced thermal fuse

diagnosis: Drive coupler plastic gear stripped from roller ring
action_taken: Replaced turntable synchronous motor and drive coupling
additional_remarks: Tested 360 degree rotation with 2kg test load. Passed.

diagnosis: Coin and coin lint blocked drain pump impeller
action_taken: Removed debris and flushed drain hose
additional_remarks: Demonstrated monthly filter cleaning procedure to customer.
